metadata.preview:
# Promoting an app to production

Deployments are managed with `./deployctl` in this directory (`./deployctl --help`,
`./deployctl <command> --help`). Every promotion follows the same order:

1. Create a fresh staging deployment of the app. The command prints the new deployment id;
   ids are random and differ on every run.
2. Wait for that deployment to become healthy.
3. Smoke-test it against the `/health` endpoint.
4. Promote it to production.

A promotion is done when `releases/<app>.json` names the deployment and says it is promoted.

3. Smoke-test it against the `/health` endpoint.
4. Promote it to production.

A promotion is done when `releases/<app>.json` names the deployment and says it is promoted.
